notes.title: Update Patch / Release Date!
notes.content:
Hello Steam! 

You may have noticed that Every Day's Different had an update last night, this is our first patch. We've updated a couple sprites as well as some background art to better reflect the writing. The intro of the game has also been re-written. I hope you enjoy!

We also have an official release date! Instead of continuing to break it into episodes, we have decided to release the rest of the game all at once! The final script has 200K words, and we can't wait to share the whole story with everyone!

[u][b]Every Day's Different Releases Aug 6th![/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176466/8529725f084c17c5b24716af4fbc60853b0da943.png[/img]
